ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution consists of approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels and 35% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large central contiguous dark pigmentation zone symmetrical about the notch; numerous small circular and oblong dark spots (mottling) distributed across both white lateral lobes; dark boundary banding visible along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 115 degrees; the vertex point is partially occluded by water surface turbulence and splashing.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; high-frequency peaks and valleys with amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels; most pronounced serration on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries follow a convex mathematical curve from the medial region tapering toward the acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast white-on-black pixel clusters located centrally; one protruding cluster of high-intensity white points (barnacles) on the extreme left lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the inner right lobe; scattered faint unaligned linear marks on the left white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep parallel rake marks on the lower right lobe; significant barnacle colonization on the far left tip causing topographical irregularity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique diagonal dark pigmentation streak located on the lower left lobe near the water line.
